mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 2 months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with tight labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 3 months signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the past month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 2% over the past quarter, the combination signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 2% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2%.
